item.title: Version 0.5.0
item.description:
• The menu now says which layout you are on and how many windows have moved since, with one click to put them back or to keep the change.
  • The window has a sidebar: your profiles, Settings and About in one place.
  • A short welcome guide on first launch.
  • Updates from inside the app, plus Report a Bug, Send Feedback and Copy Diagnostics under Help.
